summary: Scholarship to economically weaker meritorious students to help them continue education at the secondary stage.
benefits: Rs 12,000 per year (Rs 1,000/month) scholarship from class 9 to class 12.
eligibility: Students who passed class 8 with prescribed marks
Family income below the prescribed threshold
application_steps: Qualify the state-level NMMS selection test
Apply/register on the National Scholarship Portal
